faqs.q: How does buying cards from multiple stores in a single cart work?
faqs.a: TapTrade features an intelligent multi-store checkout system. You can add singles from any verified Chilean card shop into a single shopping cart. At checkout, you complete one secure transaction; funds enter TapTrade escrow and are paid directly to each store's corporate bank account, automatically generating individual courier shipping labels with Chilexpress or Starken.

faqs.q: What is the Buylist Engine and how does it empower my shop?
faqs.a: The Buylist enables your customers to sell their cards to you directly from your online storefront. The system calculates live purchase values with automated devaluation rules based on card condition (Near Mint, Lightly Played, etc.) and language. You can settle in cash or issue digital store credit with bonus incentives.

faqs.q: How does pricing work and what commissions does TapTrade charge?
faqs.a: At TapTrade we charge 0% commission on your sales (zero take-rate). We never take a percentage of your orders: 100% of what you sell is yours. We operate as a predictable SaaS monthly subscription tailored to your catalog capacity.

faqs.q: How is card condition and authenticity guaranteed?
faqs.a: All stores and verified dealers undergo legal identity and business tax ID verification. Furthermore, we enforce international TCG grading standards (Mint, Near Mint, Excellent, Lightly Played, Good, Moderately Played, Heavily Played, and Damaged). If a received card does not match the stated condition, buyers are protected with escrow returns.

faqs.q: How is the card catalog synchronized with my store?
faqs.a: Forget manual image uploads, bilingual translation, or copy-pasting rules text. TapTrade is integrated directly with Scryfall, PokémonTCG, and Riftcodex. Simply search the card name or set, and with one click you import complete official metadata with high-resolution artwork.

faqs.q: Does the Point of Sale (POS) cost extra or work when internet goes down?
faqs.a: The Point of Sale (POS) is 100% included for all stores and subscriptions at zero extra cost and zero fees. It is built with an Offline-First browser architecture using IndexedDB. If internet fails or during crowded tournaments, your cashiers can continue searching cards, scanning barcodes, taking payments, and issuing receipts. When connection returns, sales sync seamlessly without data loss.

faqs.q: How do I dispatch orders that come into my store?
faqs.a: Directly in your seller dashboard you will find a 'Generate Shipping Label' button. The platform calculates dimensions, generates official Chilexpress or Starken tracking numbers, and produces a ready-to-print shipping label to drop off at the nearest branch.

faqs.q: How does TapTrade Shield work and protect my business from fraudulent claims?
faqs.a: For orders of $20,000 CLP and above, stores take 3 mandatory packing photos: cards on invoice, rigid protective packaging, and sealed parcel with courier label across the seal. Buyers must record a continuous unboxing video without cuts to raise any dispute. This bilateral protection eliminates false empty-box or swapped-card claims, releasing your escrow funds automatically upon shipping validation.

faqs.q: How is the monthly SaaS subscription billed and how does VAT affect my taxes?
faqs.a: At month end, TapTrade issues a monthly statement totaling your base plan in UF, active extra branches (+2.50 UF/mo each), and additional staff seats. The net amount in UF is converted at the official daily rate into an electronic tax invoice with 19% VAT. That 19% VAT is a 100% deductible fiscal credit for your business against your tax obligations on Form 29 (F29).

faqs.q: Can I operate multiple physical store locations and add more staff accounts?
faqs.a: Yes. All plans include 1 base Headquarters with its foundational team (1 Owner, 1 Accountant, 1 Manager, and 1 Cashier). You can add branches for +2.50 UF/month (+ VAT) each (with isolated inventory and staff), plus individual staff seats on demand (Cashiers at +0.35 UF, Managers at +0.60 UF, Admins at +0.85 UF, or Accountants at +0.30 UF/mo + VAT).
